note: Evidence signature -> engineering checks. This table maps *what was observed* onto *what to go and look at*; it never names a mechanism as a conclusion, because no observable channel in this schema identifies one (DIAGNOSIS_CONTRACT.md 5.2). It is the small versioned local knowledge table FABOPS_VS_FABKG_BOUNDARY.md section 3 permits, and it is a data file rather than code so that a FabKG-supplied replacement is a file swap and not a release.
always: Fix the window before the subject: confirm the onset interval from the evidence rather than from when somebody noticed.
Check what else changed in the window - a recipe version, a routing shift, an inspection setting - before attributing anything to the subject.
Record the state of the subject before intervening; a repair destroys the evidence for the investigation that follows it.
insufficient_evidence: No containment action is justified: the evidence does not separate any candidate from relabelled peers.
Keep watching. Re-run the investigation when the window has more material in it, or when a monitor raises a signal on a specific entity.
If a subject is suspected on grounds outside this data, name it explicitly and re-run the impact estimate against it rather than inferring it from this report.

metrology.summary: post-step measurements departed from the recipe target relative to same-role peers
checks: Compare the subject's zonal readings against its own pre-onset window, zone by zone, before comparing it against its peers.
Rule the instrument out: re-measure a sample of the subject's wafers on a different metrology tool.
Read the subject's qualification record and any recipe or setpoint change against the onset interval.
containment: Re-measure the most exposed lots at the affected step before they move on.

fdc.summary: run summaries departed from the setpoints the recipe recorded, relative to same-role peers
checks: Read the subject's residuals parameter by parameter and identify which subsystem the departure sits in.
Check calibration and consumable-life records against the onset interval.
Verify the delivered setpoint independently of the controller reporting it.
containment: Hold further releases to the subject until the residual is explained or the subsystem is cleared.

defects.summary: the subject's wafers carry a defect rate or spatial distribution unlike its peers'
checks: Re-inspect a sample of the subject's wafers and compare the radial profile against a peer's from the same window.
Separate added defectivity from an inspection change by reading the scanner's own settings over the window.
Read the subject's clean and preventive-maintenance history against the onset interval.
containment: Re-inspect the most exposed lots; hold material that has not yet reached the next inspection step.

yield.summary: the subject's wafers yielded below their within-product peers
checks: Confirm the deficit survives a within-product comparison and exceeds the spread between peers before acting on it.
Overlay the die-bin map of the subject's worst wafers with their defect coordinates.
containment: Prioritise the most exposed lots for final-test review.
yield.caution: Cohort yield is the most attenuated channel in the chain: on twelve fault-free worlds each etch tool was the worst one on it about a third of the time (ADR-028). Treat it as corroboration, never as the reason.

alarms.summary: the subject raised more coded alarms than its same-role peers
checks: Group the subject's alarm codes by subsystem and check whether they cluster before or after the onset.
Match each escalation to a maintenance window and confirm the intervention actually happened.
alarms.caution: A healthy chamber in this fab draws background alarms and gets repaired for them by design (ADR-017). An alarm count above peers is a prompt to look, not a finding.

combinations.summary: a process departure that reached the measured result
checks: Follow the chain in one direction: which parameter moved, then whether the measured feature moved with it, then whether the two moved at the same time.
If the parameter moved and the measurement did not, suspect the reading before the process.

combinations.summary: a measured departure with a defect distribution that matches it
checks: Compare the within-wafer measurement profile against the defect radial profile on the same wafers; a shared shape is stronger evidence than either alone.

combinations.summary: the subject complained about the same subsystem its residuals moved on
checks: Check whether the alarm codes name the subsystem the residual points at; a mismatch is worth as much as a match.

combinations.summary: added defectivity that reached final test
checks: Overlay defect coordinates on the die-bin map for the subject's exposed wafers and check that the failing die are where the defects are.
